- Changes: Resized and converted to WebP; content not cropped or altered.
- Underlying rights: Photograph by Karl Baron, CC BY 2.0. Underlying sculpture is permanently displayed at UOB Plaza. Singapore Copyright Act 2021 s265 permits making and publishing photographs of permanent sculptures in public places or premises open to the public; artwork itself is not claimed public domain. See https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/CA2021?ProvIds=pr265- .
